description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a Medical Exam Preparation Chatbot that implements Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for answering questions based on textbook chapters. It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with external services like OpenAI and a vector store for document retrieval.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing local vector storage and search functionalities.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs document retrieval based on embedding similarity and generates a comprehensive answer using OpenAI's chat completion API.
